text:
Milan star Luka Modric admits the Rossoneri deserved to lose to Bologna, especially after their second-half performance: ‘We didn’t expect it.’
Milan suffered a 4-2 home loss to Bologna on Wednesday. It was the Rossoneri’s first Serie A defeat this season.
“It was a bad defeat; we didn’t expect it, especially after the first half,” Modric told Sky Sport Italia via Milannews.
“I think we had done well in the league until now, and tonight we lost our first game. We lost so many duels in the second half. That set-piece goal was unfortunate, and from that moment we threw ourselves down. We deserved to lose.
“We have no excuses. There have been injuries, but it’s a positive that the next game is right away. We had done really well until tonight, so we must stay optimistic and hope to react on Saturday,” he continued.
Modric started on the bench and was introduced during the break to replace the injured Fikayo Tomori.
Milan will face city rivals Inter in their next league game on Saturday.
Despite their latest defeat, Modric feels the Rossoneri are heading in the right direction under Ruben Amorim.
“I think we are going the right way. The coach has arrived with new ideas, with a new style of play, and we are trying to understand his ideas and what he asks of us,” the midfielder argued.
“As I said before, we had done well until tonight. You can always do more, but we still need to improve, and we hope to do it during the season.”
Milan are now fifth in the Serie A table with 18 points in nine matches. The Rossoneri have won five games, drawn three and lost once.
Modric, 41, is under contract with Milan until the end of the season. He has provided two assists in nine Serie A games so far this season.
digest_he: קשר מילאן, לוקה מודריץ, הודה בגלוי כי קבוצתו הגיעה להפסיד 4-2 לבולוניה, במשחק שהיווה את הפסד הבכורה של הרוסונרי בליגה העונה. מודריץ ציין כי המצב היה מפתיע במיוחד לאחר מחצית ראשונה טובה, אך הקבוצה הפסידה עימותים רבים במחצית השנייה וספגה שער מצב נייח שהוביל לקריסה. למרות האכזבה והפציעות, הקשר הדגיש שאין תירוצים וכי יש להישאר אופטימיים לקראת משחק הדרבי הקרוב מול אינטר. מודריץ הוסיף כי הקבוצה צועדת בכיוון הנכון תחת שרביטו של המאמן רובן אמורים, המביא עמו רעיונות וסגנון משחק חדשים. מילאן ניצבת כעת במקום החמישי בטבלה עם 18 נקודות לאחר תשעה מחזורים.
